stories.title: Golden Knights suffer 1st ever regulation loss in San Jose
stories.summary: The Golden Knights lost in regulation for the first time ever at SAP Center during the regular season, losing to the San Jose Sharks.

stories.title: Brock Bowers’ availability looms large as Raiders prepare for Browns
stories.summary: As the Las Vegas Raiders prepare for their Week 12 matchup against the Cleveland Browns, they are hopeful tight end Brock Bowers will be healthy and ready to go Sunday.

stories.title: Black Friday crowds look different in Las Vegas as shoppers chase deals
stories.summary: Some Las Vegas shoppers say online sales and earlier promotions have changed Black Friday, but retailers at the North Premium Outlets and elsewhere still drew crowds for holiday deals.

stories.title: UNLV basketball coming off its best game yet — UTRGV up next
stories.summary: The Rebels played their most complete game of the young season in an 82-61 victory against Eastern Washington on Monday.

stories.title: ESPN’s Jay Bilas is a fan of Las Vegas hosting major college basketball tournaments
stories.summary: Las Vegas has been in the college basketball spotlight over the past two weeks hosting multiple Players Era men’s events on the Strip.

stories.title: Brock Bowers questionable to play Sunday for Raiders versus Browns
stories.summary: The tight end is the team’s leader in receiving yards and touchdowns despite missing three games this season with knee and ankle injuries.

stories.title: Video shows events surrounding deadly First Friday shooting in downtown Las Vegas
stories.summary: Prosecutors allege that the killing was committed to advance a criminal gang called Loko Boys. The suspect is accused of killing 15-year-old Carth Onasi Jacobs-Rodgers.

stories.title: Nevada State license plate adds school to ranks of UNLV, UNR
stories.summary: Nevada State University is joining the ranks of UNLV and UNR by getting its own specialty license plate.

stories.title: Raiders head coach to discuss Sunday night matchup vs. Cleveland Browns
stories.summary: Head coach Klint Kubiak talks to reporters ahead of the Las Vegas Raiders’ primetime matchup with the Cleveland Browns on Sunday night.

stories.title: Road to Vegas: 5 matchups to watch in Week 13 of college football
stories.summary: Week 13 features a full slate of rivalry matchups, including three games between ranked opponents, highlighted by the UCLA Bruins taking on the USC Trojans.

stories.title: How to watch UNLV vs. UNR: TV channel, time, radio for Rebels Week 13 matchup
stories.summary: The UNLV football team is set to close out its regular-season schedule Saturday with a Week 13 clash against in-state rival, the UNR Wolf Pack, for possession of the Fremont Cannon.

stories.title: UNLV football looks to continue recent dominance over UNR
stories.summary: The Rebels have won four straight rivalry games against the Wolf Pack, keeping the Fremont Cannon red the entire time.
